resources.string: Not set\u00A0· for when face or fingerprint won’t work
On\u00A0· asked for when face or fingerprint won’t work
Set\u00A0· not asked for while “Face or fingerprint only” is off
On\u00A0· asked for now: no face or fingerprint can be used
No face or fingerprint set up\u00A0· your passphrase works for now

If your face or fingerprint won’t work, locked apps and BioKey ask for this instead of your screen lock, so don’t make it the same as your screen lock. If you forget it, nothing is lost: change or remove it here with your face or fingerprint.
If your face or fingerprint won’t work, locked apps and BioKey ask for this instead of your screen lock. The new one replaces the old one, so keep it different from your screen lock too.
Doesn’t match what you typed above
When your face or fingerprint won’t work, there’ll be no other way into locked apps and BioKey until it does. You can set a new passphrase here at any time.
Your screen lock will open locked apps and BioKey until a face or fingerprint can be used again. Only then can you set a new passphrase here.
Locked apps and BioKey won’t ask for it again. You can set a new passphrase here at any time.
